verdict.line: You lose if you eat early Parrrley poke without closing distance; you win if you land Q to stack and chain into Devour before he can Remove Scurvy the stun.

brief.thesis: This is an even matchup at 50.5% over 210 games because both champions win lane through the same mechanic: landing a CC-into-burst combo versus poking from range and denying it. Gangplank's Q (Parrrley) has a 625 range and 5s cooldown, letting him pay you back any trade you start with autos or Q; your W (Abyssal Dive) and stacked Q stun are only threatening once you've closed to point-blank. Whoever controls the gap-close window controls the lane.

theirWindow.when: Remove Scurvy is up, you're at range
theirWindow.what: He can freely trade Parrrley into you and cleanse any slow from your Q, so don't walk into poke range without a plan to close the gap.

yourWindow.when: He's used Remove Scurvy or you have 3 stacks
yourWindow.what: Land Q to stun him immediately (stacks consumed at 3), then Devour (R) him on the spot — his Grog-Soaked Blade poison won't save him from a point-blank swallow.

playing.title: Count your Q stacks
playing.detail: Every Q (Tongue Lash) that hits him applies a stack of An Acquired Taste; at 3 stacks your next Q stuns and consumes them. Track this number — it's your kill window.

playing.title: Don't trade at his Parrrley range
playing.detail: His Q has 625 range and a 5s cooldown, so standing still at range just feeds him free pokes. Close the gap with W (Abyssal Dive) before trading.

playing.title: Bait Remove Scurvy before stunning
playing.detail: If he still has Remove Scurvy (22-18s cooldown) up, he'll cleanse your Q stun instantly. Force him to waste it on a slow or poke first, then land the real stun.

playing.title: Devour on stun, not on cooldown timers
playing.detail: R (Devour) has no cooldown restriction tied to a timer — only the 3-stack requirement. The moment he's stunned and Remove Scurvy is down, swallow him immediately.

playing.title: Use W to engage, not just to escape
playing.detail: Abyssal Dive knocks up and damages all enemies in the landing area on a 21-17s cooldown. Use it proactively to close distance and force the stun-Devour sequence, not just defensively.

playing.title: Watch his E for all-in timing
playing.detail: Raise Morale buffs his damage and movement speed on a 20s cooldown. If he pops it before an engage, expect a harder trade — hold Thick Skin's shield for that window.

playing.title: Respect his ultimate near objectives
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage has a 120-110s cooldown and global range, so it's a siege tool, not a dueling threat. Don't play passively in lane just because he has it up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks above come from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade timing, stack-stun-Devour sequencing, and cooldown reads are my own tactical judgment.

stats.opponentTip: Although his (W) makes him a difficult opponent, close in after using [Q] to continue to deal damage and stun him with [Q]. If he uses (W) on the stun, use your next [P] stacks to swallow him with [W] to kill him. Be careful of being harassed by his (E) and (Q) pokes by managing your distance well.
